attribution.paper: Conneau et al., FLEURS, arXiv:2205.12446, https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.12446
attribution.modification: Subset only. Field index 3 is copied unchanged and is the scoring reference. Field index 2 is kept beside it and is not scored. Chinese field 3 is not one spacing pattern: some lines put a space between characters, and cmn_hans_cn/1663 keeps run-on Han plus a Latin name with spaces. Nothing was rewritten to look uniform. The 16 wav files are in the gitignored cache, not in git.

selection.rule: Parse the test TSV. Keep rows whose raw and normalized transcriptions are non-empty and whose audio name ends in .wav. Sort by numeric sentence id, then audio file name. Keep the first audio file of each sentence id. Take the first 8 sentence ids of each language. Later readings of the same sentence stay out of this slice.
selection.referenceField: normalized transcription, TSV field index 3 (the fourth tab-separated field)

audio.note: 16 wav files copied out of the two test tar.gz archives. The archives themselves are not stored. This is not a system hypothesis and not a product score.

normalization.en: NFKC, lower case, every run of non-letters and non-numbers becomes one space, then whitespace tokens. Metric name: wer.
normalization.zh: NFKC, then drop whitespace, punctuation, and symbols. Han characters, Latin letters, and digits stay in order, so an embedded name or number is not deleted. Spaces the publisher put around a Latin name are not word boundaries in this character comparison. Metric name: cer. This is not a second English WER on the same line.
normalization.notCombined: en and zh rates are reported separately. A shared sentence id is not a time alignment and is not a translation score.
